taste:
This basket offers crisp-coated, savoury nuggets with a soft, tender interior, served hot with chips and sweet chilli sauce. The contrast between the crunchy outside and softer centre is its main appeal. Quorn provides the plant-based alternative to chicken, while the familiar nugget format keeps the meal straightforward and easy to eat.

Sweet chilli sauce brings a sticky sweetness and tangy kick to the savoury coating. Dipping lets you choose how much of that contrast you want with each mouthful. A hearty portion of chips rounds out the basket, making it a casual pub meal rather than a plate of nuggets alone.

The basket's value lies in getting eight vegan nuggets, chips and dipping sauce together for a typical {price}. Within the {category} section, it is {pricePosition}, although prices vary by pub. That makes its position useful for comparison, rather than a promise of the same cost everywhere.

dietaryGuidance:
The Quorn No Chicken Nuggets Basket is listed as vegan and vegetarian, but its recorded allergens include cereals containing gluten and soybeans. Those tags describe its meat-free suitability, not its suitability for someone avoiding gluten or soya.

Anyone with coeliac disease or an allergy to either listed allergen should [check the current allergen](/allergen-information) information with the pub before ordering. Ask about preparation and cross-contact as well as ingredients. Swapping a side, sauce or other component can change the allergens, so check the complete amended order.
